note: The British Overseas Territory Citizen passport of Anguilla. An emergency passport costs the same and is issued only on compassionate grounds or government business (not modelled). Validity and the processing time aren't stated, leads.

sources.title: Government of Anguilla, Vital Records: Anguilla Passport Office (Fees section)
sources.said: The Fees for a British Overseas Territory Citizen Passport are as follows: Adult passport (age 16 and over) - $200.00EC Children passport (under age 16) - $150.00EC Emergency passport (Same as stated above)
